items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: Kid Punch on trumpet... myself on drum... not say because I played with him

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And in the later years, well, Punch pulled out from Jack and made his own band.
Well, who else was in that band besides you and Punch and Jack Carey?
Oh. Oh, I've seen the fella.
